lines.text: You are on the job when the call comes in, and voicemail loses it. Truckside answers instead.
This is the whole shop, run from one dashboard while you are out on the truck.
When you cannot pick up, the reception agent gets the details and books a window.
Give it a job and it builds a priced quote. You approve with one tap.
It drafts the nudges and reminders and holds each one until it is due.
The call that would have been lost is booked. Every message and charge waits for your tap. See the live demo.
